5ca6748a37b88b269472dad9: The Sea Witch steals the Guppies' magical jewels so she can rule the Seven Seas; the Guppies must get their jewels back and stop her before it's too late.
Everyone in the Old West town of Harmony Valley loves playing music together; when noisy Billy Joe Strumlouder rides into town to sabotage their tunes, Sheriff Zooli must save the day.

In Holiday Land, there's a town for every holiday until Pirate Myra uses Wizard Grouper's magic wand to turn every town into Pirate Town; it's up to Molly and Gil to restore Holiday Land back to normal.
Paddington throws a birthday party for Mateo, but things don't go according to plan; Paddington accidentally gives away Jonathan's rare Tiny Robot card in a game of Imaginarium.

Paddington hurts his knee and goes to see Dr Yasmin; when she steps out, he steps up and is mistaken for a doctor. Can Mr. Brown's sleepover live up to Mrs. Brown's high standard when Simi and Toq come to stay for the night.
Paddington and the kids overhear Mr. Brown talking about selling the house; the kids are playing in the garden and make a prickly discovery.

Paddington nurses an injured bird back to health and discovers a new friend in Pigeonton; Mr. Brown creates a list of chores for Paddington, who accidentally picks up the wrong list.
It's time for the annual fun run in Windsor Gardens Park, but Paddington is not very fit; Jonathan, Judy and Paddington accidentally break Mrs. Bird's much-loved rocking chair.
Paddington takes Jonathan to the park to fly a kite when Mr. Brown is stuck at home.
When Nonny breaks his glasses, he must use his other senses to reach the glasses store.
Deema has a loose tooth; the Guppies learn about keeping a healthy smile.
When their friend's moving day does not go as planned, Molly, Gil and the Guppy Movers head out to set things right in his new home.
Mr. Bull builds a clubhouse for Peppa and her friends; the children set up a detective club; the children pretend to run a little shop; Peppa and her friends create stories about wild animals.
Peppa and George go sailing with Grandpa Pig, but he keeps getting the boat stuck in the mud; they all decide to have a sleepover on the boat while they wait for the tide to come back in.
Madame Gazelle and the playgroup share their best nursery rhymes; Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to Digger World, where they build walls and knock them over again.

Peppa, George, Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig go to visit the Kangaroo family in Australia and get to explore the Outback.

Peppa and her friends search for Easter eggs; Grandpa Pig organizes a chocolate egg hunt; Peppa and George spend the day at Rebecca Rabbit's house; Mummy Rabbit comes to visit with a big tummy; Daddy Pig gives Peppa and Suzy a box of garden games.
Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat does not get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig.
While celebrating Friendship Day, the pups must prevent Mayor Humdinger from ruining Adventure Bay's reputation as the friendliest town on the map.
Francois and Turbot learn an underwater volcano is going to erupt; Farmer Yumi and Mayor Goodway are scuba diving nearby; Farmer Al's farm is flooded.
The pups plan to race each other on Adventure Bay Race Day; Mr. Porter enters a cake competition.
All is not well in the normally well-rested Kingdom of Sleepwell because Princess Deema can't fall asleep; her royal court comes to her aid, but even magic doesn't work.
The Bubble Guppies learn about colors while car racing.

Mix and Rubble are starstruck when their favorite TV renovation star, Hank Hammer, comes to see them at work; Cap'n Turbot is bringing Mayor Goodway to visit her sister, Mayor Greatway; when a fog rolls in, the pups must build a lighthouse quickly.
After the crew builds a special lemonade stand for Lucas and Lily, a sour Speed Meister sends it rolling through Builder Cove; Rubble & Crew build a bridge to help Crunchy the beaver cross the road.
When supervillain Lady Goo Goo starts changing everyone into babies, it's up to Guppy Girl and Bubble Boy to stop her before they get turned into babies too!
Starla's prize pig Zippy enters a race; when a competitor sends Zippy far away, Blaze, AJ and Starla must get the pig back to the race in time.

When Axle City is visited by a littering raccoon, it's up to Blaze to save the day as a Super Recycling Truck; he cleans up the town and rescues his friends just in time for a final showdown with the Litter Critter.
When Blaze and Crusher discover a medieval kingdom is holding a royal race, the two trucks become knights in order to compete.
Crusher steals all of Gabby's tools, and Blaze must help her retrieve them so she can repair the Monster Machines.
For the first time ever, Blaze and AJ race under the ocean; Blaze transforms into a submarine and speeds through sunken ships and coral reefs to reach the giant sand castle at the finish line.
Blaze and his friends head to VelocityVille to participate in a race through the snow called the Polar Derby.
Officer Blaze just got his biggest case yet, tracking down the mischievous Treat Thief, and with help from Officer Anna, Blaze sets out to stop the thief and recover every stolen treat.
When Blaze and Starla encounter a herd of cows wandering in the desert, they embark on a wild west adventure to bring the cows back to Starla's barn.
Blaze and AJ take off into space for a race that's out of this world; along the way to Planet Victory, they meet friendly aliens, dodge asteroids, and face off against Crusher's spaceship.

The Cadets send stressed Shirley on a remote treetop cabin vacation when she accidentally unmoors the cabin; Baddy wants to be in Reg Goosling's best adventure picture ever, but the Cadets rescue Baddy and end up in the picture instead.
